nodes.name: Recorder - conversation analyzed
nodes.notes: Point your recorder's 'conversation analyzed' webhook here. The payload should carry the call id and the deal owner (rep).

nodes.name: Recorder - fetch call
nodes.notes: Fetch the analyzed call (transcript + attendees). No Gong? Swap for your recorder's API, or ingest the export via the dealtrace adapters.

nodes.name: Slack - DM the draft to the rep
nodes.notes: DM ONLY, to the rep (deal owner). Do not add a 'send to customer' action. Map the rep's Slack user id from the trigger payload if you have it.

main.node: Slack - DM the draft to the rep
